central_hypothesis.statement: Because Gamma means that the second branch of S reaches a local maximum whose gain lies in (0, ell), Gamma is contained in the event that the field has at least one local maximum with value in (b-ell,b). Therefore a global pair-Palm maximum-window first moment can supersede the selected-maximum Malliavin density route for the upper bound.
central_hypothesis.kill_condition: A counterexample to the deterministic event inclusion, or a proof that the required maximum-window first moment cannot be made O(ell) under the typed six-pin pair-Palm law.
